notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
New object is added: Evil Eye!

New levels: 4-1, 4-2, 4-3.

Settings screen is re-worked. Now all settings are in one place with better UI.

Minor fixes.

notes.title: Level Editor is now available!
notes.content:
Now you can create your own levels and upload them to Steam Workshop.
Please find detailed manual here: [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zczEQXVzJuVi9tOwhWvfQUflAv9KagOjNUzj90EcAlA]PtE: Level Editor Manual[/url]

To play custom level - go to Workshop, find level that you like and subscribe to it.
Restart the game to download the level. It will be available in User Levels tab.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36824303/88d6017e4368089d40c5ef74bffb3dd9e01949fe.gif[/img]

Level Editor will be enhanced in the nearest future. Please do not hesitate to add your feedback, suggest new feature or point an issue.
